questions.question: Why has Misato Kuroi taken care of Riko since she was four?
questions.subject: Riko Amanai/Synopsis

answer.item: When she was four years old, her parents died in a car accident. She has been cared for by Misato Kuroi since then.

questions.question: Who attacked Riko's hotel before Gojo and Geto arrived?
questions.subject: Riko Amanai/Synopsis

answer.item: Before Gojo and Geto arrived at her hotel, she was attacked by Kokun from Q, causing an explosion that blasted an unconscious Riko out of the room.
As Riko reached out, she was suddenly shot in the head by Toji, killing her instantly.

questions.question: Which Star Plasma Vessel did Tengen say had the greatest potential?
questions.subject: Riko Amanai/Synopsis

answer.item: Riko was mentioned to have had the greatest potential among the Star Plasma Vessels.

questions.question: What was Riko doing in Gojo's afterlife?
questions.subject: Riko Amanai/Synopsis

answer.item: Riko appeared in Gojo's afterlife, in which she was talking with Misato.
